source: BHPS Class VI French midterm model paper 2026-27 + teaching notes, Chapter 5

overview.bigIdea: Discover **France**: its symbols, rivers and mountains, neighbours, monuments and food. Section D = 20 marks.
overview.languagesTitle: Three things to be able to do

lessons.title: Symboles de la France
lessons.hook: Why is France called **l’Hexagone**? Look at its map – it has **six sides**!

core.def: France’s shape looks like a hexagon.
Symbol of France and the French people.
Represents the supreme authority – M. Emmanuel Macron (answer key 2026-27).
Capital, in the north, on the Seine.

explain: La France se trouve en Europe.

example.answer: Parce que sa forme ressemble à un hexagone.

mistakes: Confusing la Marseillaise (anthem) with Marseille (a city).
lessons.tip: Answer in a full French sentence.
lessons.memory: Six sides, a rooster and a song – that’s France!

play.title: Symbols of France
play.say: Match each symbol with what it is.

lessons.title: Géographie de la France
lessons.hook: La **Manche** separates France from England. The **Garonne** is a river and the **Pyrénées** are mountains.

core.def: la Seine, la Loire, la Garonne, le Rhône
les Alpes, les Pyrénées, le Jura, les Vosges, le Massif central
la Manche, la Méditerranée (and the Atlantic ocean)
Belgique, Luxembourg, Allemagne, Suisse, Italie, Monaco, Andorre, Espagne

explain: Model paper Q13(c): « La France est entourée par sept pays » – Faux.
Transport: train, métro, bus, tramway, voiture, vélo, avion.

example.q: La Garonne est une ___ en France.

mistakes: Calling England a land neighbour – it is across the Manche.
lessons.tip: Group names into rivers / mountains / seas.
examAsk: Nommez les pays voisins de la France.
Vrai ou faux about the Manche.

lessons.title: Monuments, nourriture et personnes
lessons.hook: The **Tour Eiffel** was built by Gustave Eiffel; the **Louvre** is a museum; the **baguette** is bread and **camembert** is cheese.

core.def: la Tour Eiffel, le Louvre (musée), l’Arc de Triomphe, Notre-Dame
la baguette (pain), le camembert (fromage), le croissant
Gustave Eiffel (engineer of the tower); actors Gérard Depardieu and Jean Reno

explain: Model paper Q13: Le camembert est un vin – Faux · Le Louvre est un musée – Vrai · La baguette est un pain – Vrai.

example.q: Le camembert est un vin français. Vrai ou faux ?

lessons.tip: Learn each name with its category (musée, pain, fromage).
lessons.memory: Tower by Eiffel, art in the Louvre, bread is a baguette!
examAsk: Quels sont les monuments en France ?

play.title: What is it?
play.say: Sort each one into its group.

formulas.name: Mountains / seas
formulas.unit: La Manche sépare la France de l’Angleterre

revision: **Hexagone, coq, Marseillaise**, bleu-blanc-rouge; capital **Paris** on the Seine.
Rivers: **Seine, Loire, Garonne, Rhône**; mountains: **Alpes, Pyrénées**.
**Louvre** = museum; **baguette** = bread; **camembert** = cheese; Tour Eiffel by **Gustave Eiffel**.

paper.what: Vrai ou faux (camembert, Manche, neighbours, Louvre, baguette)

sections.title: Culture answers
items: Use the exact French name (la Seine, le Louvre).
For vrai/faux, check the category (fromage vs vin).

sections.title: Writing answers that score
items: Copy the spelling carefully – accents count (é, è, ê, ç).
Always start a sentence with a capital letter and end with a full stop or question mark.
Before writing a verb, find the subject first (je, tu, il, nous…) and use the matching ending.
For negation, check two things: ne…pas around the verb, and un/une/des → de after pas.
In descriptions write 5 simple sentences: name → where → what you see or do → why you like it → a feeling.
Answer culture questions in a full sentence: ‘La capitale de la France est Paris.’

sections.title: The day before the test
items: Say each verb table aloud once (je, tu, il, nous, vous, ils).
Redo the Play & learn activities – aim for every card right first time.
Take one Check knowledge quiz at Hard level.

checklist: I can explain l’Hexagone, le coq and la Marseillaise.
I can name French rivers and mountains.
I can name French monuments and foods.
I can do culture vrai/faux questions.
exam.paperTitle: In the Class VI midterm model paper
exam.paperNote: BHPS Class VI French midterm model paper 2026-27 (80 marks: Reading 10 · Writing 20 · Grammar 30 · Culture 20). Practise these question types first.

method: Built on how languages stick: hear and see short patterns, practise them many times with instant feedback, say answers aloud before checking (active recall), and revisit after 1, 3 and 7 days (spaced revision).
